# PDXScholar: The Institutional Repository of Portland State University

> > PDXScholar is Portland State University's institutional repository for preserving, sharing, and discovering open-access scholarly works, research, and academic publications.

PDXScholar serves as PSU's central hub for institutional research, powered by the Digital Commons platform. The repository aggregates dissertations, theses, faculty publications, open educational resources, and specialized research collections from across Portland State University's departments, centers, and archives.

## Key Topics

- Institutional Repository
- Open Access
- Scholarly Works

## Getting Started

- [PDXScholar: The Institutional Repository of Portland State University](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu): PDXScholar homepage: PSU's institutional repository for academic and scholarly content
- [About | PDXScholar](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/about.html): About PDXScholar: mission, open access, and Digital Commons integration
- [Submit Your Research | PDXScholar](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/submit_research.html): Guide for submitting research, theses, and scholarly works to PDXScholar
- [Please Log In](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): PDXScholar user login and authentication portal for account access

## Browse Collections

- [Dissertations and Theses | Portland State University Research](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/etds): PDXScholar dissertations, theses, and electronic thesis collections
- [Schools, Colleges, Departments, and Administrative Units](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/communities): Directory of PSU colleges, departments, and administrative units in PDXScholar
- [Research Centers, Institutes, and Collaborations](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/centers): Browse PSU research centers, institutes, and collaborative organizations
- [Special Collections and University Archives](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/archives): PSU Special Collections, archives, and Oregon Black Pioneers collections
- [Featured Collections | PDXScholar](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/featured.html): Featured PDXScholar collections including OER and homelessness research

## Scholarly Resources

- [Journals | Portland State University Research](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/journals): PSU open access journals and peer-reviewed scholarly publications
- [PDXOpen: Open Educational Resources | Portland State University](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/pdxopen): PDXOpen: PSU's open educational resources and grant program
- [Conferences and Symposia | Portland State University Research](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/conferences): PDXScholar conferences, symposia, and academic events collections

## Discovery & Notifications

- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/communities.html): Browse PDXScholar collections by PSU research units, centers, and departments
- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/announcements.html): Email alerts and RSS feed subscription options for PDXScholar content

- [Most Popular Papers | PDXScholar](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/topdownloads.html): Most downloaded and popular papers in PDXScholar repository

- [Leadership for Sustainability: Theoretical Foundations and Pedagogical](https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/elp_fac/45): Faculty publication on leadership for sustainability and pedagogical practices
